content_fields.title: Protect backup archive bits
content_fields.description: Protect database backup archives so a backup cannot become an easier path to the data.
content_fields.guidance: Backups should be encrypted with keys distinct from the live database, stored with restricted access and integrity protection, and periodically test-restored.
content_fields.found: No backup process is defined anywhere in the repository; the database volume is the only copy of the data.
content_fields.missing: A backup process, its storage destination and key custody.
content_fields.conclusion: Backup protection is an operational process defined outside this repository.
content_fields.action: The database administration team should define encrypted, access-controlled backups with restore testing.
